description: HACKY diagnostic, fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). Each LUT module = LUT(x) + Linear(x) in parallel, summed (LinearParallelLut). Plain dense Linear, zero-init (starts == exp453, grows in cleanly). Reintroduces dense matmuls (NOT matmul-free) — purely to probe whether adding dense linear capacity helps the LUT body converge / lowers the floor. Linears are cheap (~560K total, LUT inputs are low-dim E=64/96). Linear weights on AdamW, base LUT on LION. Run in parallel with exp462. Saves checkpoint.
